summary: Frontend-only test of new 'Download E-Ticket' button in /preorder (WalkinPage) result dialog. Logged in as admin1/admin123, created both a 'Belum Berdana' pre-order (ZZTEST Download belum, seat M18, order #8330) and a 'Sudah Berdana' pre-order (transfer, Rp 100.000, seat M17, order #8700). In both result dialogs the new button data-testid='walkin-result-download' is present and positioned between walkin-result-wa and walkin-result-ok (verified DOM order: ['walkin-result-wa','walkin-result-download','walkin-result-ok']). Clicking it triggered a real Playwright download event with correct filenames e-ticket-8330.png (155 KB) and e-ticket-8700.png (162 KB), and the success toast 'E-ticket tersimpan sebagai gambar' appeared. Zero JS/console errors or page errors during canvas generation (saveTicketImage). All ZZTEST data cleaned via DELETE /api/admin/manual/{id} (both returned 200, no ZZTEST records remain).

issues: Non-blocking React a11y warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}' logged twice when result dialog opens — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby

WalkinPage.js is 1116 lines; consider splitting (login, checkin panel, order form, dialogs) per file-size guideline
